content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Zila Panchayat Balod Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.balod.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Zila Panchayat Balod, Chhattisgarh, for filling up various contractual positions across different departments under the district administration.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under Zila Panchayat Balod Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies available for various posts including Computer Programmer, Programme Officer, Sahayak Programmer, and Lekhapal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates must download the application form, fill it out completely, and send it by post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of completed offline application forms is 16-10-2026. Applications received after this date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Zila Panchayat Balod Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 45 years of age. Age relaxations are provided for reserved category candidates as per Chhattisgarh government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required for the Lekhapal post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Lekhapal post must have passed Higher Secondary with at least 50% marks along with basic knowledge of computer applications.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General, OBC, SC, or ST candidates applying for Zila Panchayat Balod recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Zila Panchayat Balod positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves preparing a merit list based on educational qualifications and relevant experience, followed by a Computer Practical or Skill Test.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary for the Computer Programmer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Computer Programmer (Male) post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 51,780/-.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form directly from the official website of Balod district at www.balod.gov.in.
